description: This file contains database query functions related to managing card limits and active cards in a project management system, including retrieving and updating timestamps and counts for cards.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer with methods for managing card limit data.

methods.name: activeCardsQuery
methods.description: Builds a query to fetch active cards with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: getUsedCardsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active cards in the system.

methods.name: getCardLimitTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the card limit from system settings.

methods.name: updateCardLimitTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for the card limit based on the nth last updated card.
